g.text: 14 nodes (pipeline/graph.py build_graph). Solid blue: runs in both modes. Dashed: review mode only (teacher_review_v1, on by default).
Routers are pure functions that only read state (ADR-024). Orange boxes pause the run with interrupt(); orange arrows are the teacher-hold paths.
Page magic pencil: a separate job, outside the graph
Runs on a finished book (app/page_pencil.py, worker/page_pencil.py).
then one RQ job worker.page_pencil.run_page_pencil edits the page
image and screens it. At most 5 per book. Flagged text is held for
the teacher; the checkpoint is not resumed.
3 try-again or pencil taps per book (MAX_RETRY_TAPS)
Baseline (review off): a flag at input_gate,
char_ref_mod (after its one redraw) or output_mod
fails the job. No partial book.
Review mode (default): the flag is held for the
teacher at moderation_review. allow returns to
return_node, one of 11 nodes; replace runs
Source: backend/pipeline/graph.py (nodes, edges, routers), pipeline/reveal.py, pipeline/moderation_review.py, pipeline/char_ref_mod.py,
pipeline/moderation_replace.py, app/page_pencil.py, worker/page_pencil.py, app/config.py. As built 2026-11-21.
